opt: Stability with chosen Schur tails
snippet: In the setting of thm:trace-class-rigidity-consequences, the stability results proved in this section are pinching and finite-window consequences of trace minimality. Near-minimal trace defect controls chosen Schur upper-tail entries and, in finite dimension, distance to the normal minimizer class. They do not assert a basis-free global orbit-distance theorem in infinite dimension without the chosen-tail hypotheses.
